response.sql: WITH op AS (SELECT crewref, SUM(scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), valid AS (SELECT * FROM op WHERE avg_gb_per_min IS NOT NULL), g AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS overall_avg FROM valid) SELECT AVG(v.total_scans) AS avg_total_scans, AVG(v.avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(v.avg_gb_per_min - g.overall_avg) AS avg_margin_above_overall FROM valid v CROSS JOIN g WHERE v.avg_gb_per_min > g.overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: The ratio gbsize/spanmin is computed per scan row. Rows with NULL gbsize or NULL/zero spanmin are excluded from the ratio average. A zero spanmin is treated as missing to avoid division by zero.
The all-operator average is the unweighted mean of each operator's average GB/min. It covers operators that have at least one valid ratio.
Total scans per operator sums scancount over all of that operator's scan rows. NULL scancount values are ignored, including rows whose ratio is missing.

alternatives.interpretation: Total scans are summed only over rows that also have a valid GB/min ratio, so both metrics use the same rows.
alternatives.sql: WITH op AS (SELECT crewref, SUM(scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(gbsize * 1.0 / spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY crewref), g AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS overall_avg FROM op) SELECT AVG(op.total_scans) AS avg_total_scans, AVG(op.avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(op.avg_gb_per_min - g.overall_avg) AS avg_margin_above_overall FROM op CROSS JOIN g WHERE op.avg_gb_per_min > g.overall_avg
